title: Clinical consistency rules: laterality & diagnostic evidence cross-checking

test_cases.name: Laterality mismatch detection
test_cases.input_setup: Cross-check complaint 'left knee' with ICD-10 'right knee'
test_cases.expected_result: Conflict string returned identifying left vs right mismatch
test_cases.evidence: Laterality mismatch caught: Laterality mismatch detected: Clinical text mentions 'left' (tokens: left), but recommended code specifies 'right'.

test_cases.name: Diagnosis without clinical evidence warning
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate diagnosis 'Pneumonia' against isolated 'Sprained ankle' findings
test_cases.expected_result: Caution banner emitted indicating lack of supporting clinical evidence
test_cases.evidence: Unsubstantiated diagnosis flagged with caution banner: Caution: Diagnosis 'J18.9 - Pneumonia, unspecified' has no documented supporting evidence (e.g. none of pneumonia) found in symptoms, physical exam, or history.

test_cases.name: Consistent laterality pass
test_cases.input_setup: Cross-check 'right eye' in complaints and 'right eye' in code description
test_cases.expected_result: Zero warnings or conflicts emitted (conflict is None)
test_cases.evidence: Consistent right eye laterality passed with zero warnings

test_cases.name: Bilateral laterality validation
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate 'bilateral knee pain' against 'bilateral knee' ICD-10 description
test_cases.expected_result: Accepted as valid bilateral presentation; zero false-positive conflicts
test_cases.evidence: Bilateral laterality detected and accepted across findings and code description

test_cases.name: Multiple independent anatomical checks
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate shoulder mismatch and wrist match in succession
test_cases.expected_result: Each anatomical pair evaluated independently without state crosstalk
test_cases.evidence: Multiple lateralized anatomical evaluations executed cleanly and independently
